Container.Name: nvpair
Container.Overview: Unofficial headless NVIDIA PAIR wrapper for Linux/amd64. Uses the greggee/nvpair-container image from Docker Hub and requires a separate Ollama backend on host loopback port 11434. Restrict host-network listeners to the trusted LAN before starting. Optional NVIDIA utility telemetry requires the host NVIDIA runtime.

Config.Name: PAIR state
Config.Description: Fresh private state, owned by UID/GID 10002; contains identity keys. Never share across nodes.

Config.Name: Require local Ollama
Config.Description: Health check requires an adopted local Ollama.

Config.Name: Ollama backend port
Config.Description: Expected adopted backend port; does not relocate Ollama.

Config.Name: PAIR proxy port
Config.Description: Expected proxy port; does not configure its listener.

Config.Name: NVIDIA GPU UUID
Config.Description: Optional: replace void with GPU UUID and add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: NVIDIA capabilities
Config.Description: Management telemetry only; Ollama separately needs compute access.
